context: Tests whether the agent correctly authors the-mister work orders: git-tier orders include inline directory on every command and verbatim-output instructions; Hard orders describe behavioral outcomes rather than implementation recipes; Medium orders are either downgraded to Easy (literal steps) or kept as Medium (outcome-based); commit orders use git commit -F with a .msg file, never an inline -m message; and no order leaks cache-env redirections or worktree-isolation calls.

checklist.name: Inline dirs all commands
checklist.description: Every git/shell command across ALL order files (orders/N01-baseline.md through orders/N04-commit.md) carries its working directory inline on the same line using 'git -C <dir>' or 'cd <dir> &&'; no order uses a bare command whose only directory context is a preceding 'run from <dir>' sentence

checklist.name: Verbatim output required
checklist.description: orders/N01-baseline.md explicitly instructs the git operator to paste the complete, verbatim (not summarized or excerpted) output of every command in their report

checklist.name: Output labelled by command
checklist.description: orders/N01-baseline.md instructs the git operator to label each block of output by the specific command that produced it

checklist.name: Hard = behavioral outcome
checklist.description: orders/N02-cache.md describes a behavioral outcome (what must be true when the node is accepted), NOT a step-by-step recipe of edits, function signatures to write, or specific implementation instructions

checklist.name: Medium/Easy N03 coherent
checklist.description: orders/N03-tests.md is internally coherent: either written as an Easy node (literal, executable step-by-step commands with explicit paths) OR as a Medium node (outcome-based acceptance criteria), not a mixture of both styles

checklist.name: git commit -F syntax
checklist.description: orders/N04-commit.md uses 'git commit -F <path>' syntax to perform the commit, NOT 'git commit -m "..."' with an inline typed message

checklist.name: .msg file reference
checklist.description: orders/N04-commit.md references a file with a .msg extension that contains the commit message content

checklist.name: Explicit git add paths
checklist.description: orders/N04-commit.md uses 'git add' with explicit file or directory paths, NOT '-A', '.', or '--all'

checklist.name: No worktree isolation
checklist.description: No order file contains the string 'isolation: "worktree"' or invokes the EnterWorktree tool

checklist.name: No cache env redirection
checklist.description: No order file sets GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE, npm_config_cache, CARGO_HOME, or similar tool cache variables to paths inside the state directory, scratch/, or captures/
